attempted_claim: For the 3+1 timelike extremal-hypersurface graph equation div(∇_{t,x}φ/√(1+|∇_xφ|^2−(∂_tφ)^2))=0 on Minkowski R^{1+3} linearized about the nontrivial traveling-wave family φ_v(t,x)=ψ(x_1−vt,x_2,x_3) with |v|<1, consider transverse graph perturbations with compactly supported smooth data of size ε=‖(φ−φ_v,∂_tφ−∂_tφ_v)|_{t=0}‖_{H^N×H^{N−1}}, N≥8, with timelikeness 1+|∇_xφ|^2−(∂_tφ)^2≥c_0>0 initially: prove or disprove that for all 0<ε≤ε_0(v,ψ) the solution stays smooth timelike for all t≥0 with Klainerman vector-field energy bounded and pointwise decay |∂(φ−φ_v)|≤Cε(1+t)^{−1}, and otherwise establish the sharp lifespan law T_ε≥exp(c/ε) versus a matching finite-time upper bound T_ε≤exp(C/ε) along some ε_j→0; a complete answer is a global-regularity-plus-decay theorem or an explicit blow-up/lifespan-upper-bound sequence falsifying it.

decisive_failure: originality: TARGET headline fails originality: global nonlinear stability of flat timelike planes in 3+1 with bounded energy and (1+t)^-1 decay is already the Allen-Andersson-Isenberg flat-plane theorem (arbitrary codimension, n>=2, q>=1), which substantively implies the draft's affine subluminal traveling-plane subfamily since the graph of r(x1-vt)+b2x2+b3x3+c is a flat timelike plane (tilt/boost of trivial plane). AAI assumes the same H^N compact data, proves the same M1/M2 boundedness and N-decay (1+t)^-(n-1)/2, and uses the same divergence plus null structure. The Bernstein A-minimal reduction for |c|<1 and affine conclusion were already published in Liu-Zhou 1903.04129 Sec.1 (Eqs.1.3-1.4), which explicitly attributes |c|<1 flat-plane stability to Allen et al. Hence the combination is a corollary/repackaging of a known stronger fact, not a new claim; snippet absence or timestamp cannot establish priority.
